description: tools/fixtures/unified-lighting built with the prebuilt web player (jasperengine-editor build --platform web, S30 AC2) with Web: Multithreaded on, in the headless shell (SwiftShader WebGL2): served with COOP/COEP, or without them (coi-serviceworker.js isolates the page after one reload). Either way the pthreads player runs. The player runs 3 frames after ready at a fixed 60 fps and quits (?quit-after=3&fixed-fps=60&after-ready), so the page is still while it is captured; software WebGL needs a long capture_timeout for this scene. The centre pixel is the grey floor between the middle cylinders.
